title: Coffee starting frame — patron farther ahead
prompt:
Edit the supplied image into the STARTING FRAME of Riley's first-person coffee-rescue scene. Fix the blocking before any video animation. One photoreal 16:9 frame, at normal standing eye height, looking straight down the sidewalk.

CHANGE:
Move the SAME middle-aged man and his ONE white mug out of the immediate foreground and place him about FIVE METRES AHEAD along the LEFT cafe frontage. He must be a fully visible, naturally smaller person in the middle distance, roughly one third of the image height, positioned just left of Riley's forward walking line, around the left-middle of the image rather than at the extreme edge. Show ample empty paving between Riley and him. Remove his original large foreground body completely and restore the cafe and paving behind it. There is only one instance of this man.

Riley's clear walking lane runs straight forward close alongside the cafe, passing about 60–80 centimetres to the RIGHT of the man's mug hand. He stands just beside that lane, not in its centre and not on the distant opposite side of the sidewalk. The intended later encounter happens beside Riley within one arm's reach. The starting view is still several steps BEFORE she reaches him; she has not passed him.

The man casually holds the single small white mug upright by its handle near his waist on the side facing the walking lane. His free arm rests naturally. He is not reaching to Riley, not offering the mug and not throwing anything. The mug is NOT falling yet in this starting image. It will slip only when Riley draws level with him in the subsequent video. No airborne mug, splash or duplicate cup.

Keep Riley's two normal-sized human hands with fine chrome/cyan inlays low at the bottom corners in a relaxed walking arm swing. No reaching, oversized hands, extended arms or visible third-person Riley. Clear the nearby pedestrians from Riley's immediate route; distant pedestrians may remain well beyond the man.

PRESERVE:
Same man's face, salt-and-pepper hair, stubble and charcoal futuristic jacket. Same cyberpunk cafe on the left, bronze/dark glass architecture, cyan/magenta lighting, trees, reflective paving, warm daylight, elevated train infrastructure on the right and coherent street perspective. Keep the natural photographic style and existing skin/chrome design. Reframe only enough to establish this forward-looking approach.

The essential readable composition: long open foreground -> man waiting farther ahead on the LEFT edge of Riley's lane -> open city beyond. A clear later passing distance of one arm's reach, not a collision course or a distant rescue. No extra foreground man, mug, diagram, arrows, labels, captions or watermark.

connected_to.label: IMAGE 3 — Approved cyberpunk cafe world; opening direction is prompt-defined

references.role: Existing cafe world and patron, position to be corrected

authorization: User rejects MiniMax orbit test, identifies too-close starting reference, requests man farther ahead before passing and lateral discovery of the airborne mug.
future_motion_constraints: Draw level with patron before side glance; do not pass and turn back.
At sideways discovery, cup is already separated from his empty hand and descending; no prior handoff or upward toss.
Cup remains beside Riley within a bent-arm reach, under the patron's mug hand; no drift toward camera or across the sidewalk.
FPP to TPP slow-motion camera orbit around physical catch; cup stays above paving.
Starting still is pre-drop; no video generation until composition is reviewed.

assistant_visual_review.method: Native 1280x720 image inspection against cafe v03; no generated motion in this pass.
observations: Same patron is now a smaller full-body figure farther ahead on the left instead of occupying the immediate foreground.
Open paving separates Riley from the patron; nearby pedestrians have been cleared from the immediate route.
Cafe on left, elevated transit on right, reflective pavement and cyan/magenta lighting maintain the established city.
Riley remains first person with lowered natural-sized skin/chrome hands; the hero mug is upright before the drop.
limitations: The mug remains near the patron's chest and on the cafe side of his body, rather than low on the lane-facing side; this is still an important reach/trajectory constraint for motion.
A second background cup is visible on the far-left cafe table. The hero mug must remain distinct in animation.
Exact five-metre distance and 60–80cm later passing separation are prompting targets, not measured geometry.
No still can verify a downward fall, timely side glance or circular camera move. Those remain motion tests; this image is not selected automatically.
Some architecture and small face details changed during the edit.

followup_edit.notes: Still candidate remains v04. Distance improved, but requested hand/table-cup edit did not take.

latest_user_feedback.quote: Looks ok, but you have two hands, should only be 1 hand. So that it looks like she was already running.
latest_user_feedback.scope: Positive overall composition feedback; remove one foreground arm, not a final take lock.
